info.title: Enrich Layer API v3
info.description: Successful requests consume API credits. Failed requests (4xx/5xx) are not charged.

get.description: Look up a person by any identifier: an email address, or a LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter/X, or GitHub username or profile URL. One of them is required; if several are given, only the first in this order is used: github, email, profile, facebook, twitter.

x-codeSamples.label: JavaScript
Go
x-codeSamples.source:
req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", "https://api.enrichlayer.com/v3/person?profile=https%3A%2F%2Flinkedin.com%2Fin%2Fsatyanadella%2F&personalEmail=include", nil)
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY")

resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)

x-codeSamples.label: Python
x-codeSamples.source:
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "https://api.enrichlayer.com/v3/person?profile=https%3A%2F%2Flinkedin.com%2Fin%2Fsatyanadella%2F&personalEmail=include",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"},
)
person = response.json()

Go
x-codeSamples.source:
req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", "https://api.enrichlayer.com/v3/company?url=https%3A%2F%2Flinkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fmicrosoft%2F&fundingData=include", nil)

response = requests.get(

    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"},
